welcome.title: Welcome to AssetSouq
welcome.body: This is where you browse IT devices the company is retiring and register your interest in one. A short tour will show you around — you can skip it any time.

devicesHeader.title: Your devices page
devicesHeader.body: This is your home base for the raffle. Your name and a quick way to sign out are always here.

devicesGrid.title: Browse available devices
devicesGrid.body: Every device currently open for entry appears here as a card. New devices are added as they become available.

deviceCard.title: A device card
deviceCard.body: Each card shows the device and its price. Select View Details to see full specs and register your interest.

registrationForm.title: Review the details
registrationForm.body: Check the specs and read the terms before registering. You can only have one active registration at a time, so pick carefully.

registrationSubmit.title: Register your interest
registrationSubmit.body: Agree to the terms and submit to enter the draw. If you're selected, you'll be notified right here and asked to complete payment.

registrationStatus.title: Track your registration
registrationStatus.body: Once you've registered, this card replaces the device list and shows your current status — pending, eligible, or a result.

notifications.title: Where updates appear
notifications.body: AssetSouq doesn't have a separate notifications inbox — status changes like this one show up right where they're relevant, so you never have to go looking for them.

account.title: Signing out
account.body: Use this button any time you're done for the day. There's no separate account page to manage — signing in is tied to your staff number.

helpMenu.title: Help is always nearby
helpMenu.body: This button follows you everywhere. Come back here to replay this tour, check what's new, or switch languages.

complete.title: You're all set
complete.body: That's everything you need to know. Head back to the devices list whenever you're ready to register your interest.

welcome.title: Welcome, admin
welcome.body: This tour walks through managing devices, employees, and the raffle draw. Skip any time — you can always come back to it later.

dashboardStats.title: Your dashboard at a glance
dashboardStats.body: These cards summarize devices, employees, and registrations in real time. Check here first each day to see what needs attention.

dashboardCharts.title: Status breakdowns
dashboardCharts.body: These charts show how devices and registrations are distributed across each status, so you can spot backlogs at a glance.

devicesManagement.title: Manage devices
devicesManagement.body: Every device lives in this table with its price, status, and quick actions. Edit, run a draw, remove, or restore a device right from here.

devicesFilter.title: Filter by status
devicesFilter.body: Narrow the table to just Available, Removed, Drawn, or Sold devices — useful once the list grows.

deviceForm.title: Add or edit a device
deviceForm.body: Fill in the specs and price, then save. Required fields are validated as you go, so you'll know right away if something's missing.

employeesImport.title: Bulk import employees
employeesImport.body: Upload an Excel (.xlsx) file to create or update many employees at once, instead of adding them one by one.

quickLinks.title: Jump to any section
quickLinks.body: Registrations, winners, reports, and the audit log are all one click away from here.

notifications.title: Where updates appear
notifications.body: AssetSouq doesn't have a separate notifications inbox — after you run a draw, the result appears right on the devices page, in context.

account.title: Signing out
account.body: Your admin account also has a password. If you're still using the default setup credentials, the dashboard has a one-time prompt to replace them — beyond that, there's no self-service way to change it yet, so reach out to have it reset if you ever need to.

helpMenu.title: Help is always nearby
helpMenu.body: This button follows you everywhere. Come back here to replay this tour, check what's new, or switch languages.

complete.title: You're ready to go
complete.body: That covers the essentials. Head to Registrations to see what's waiting for review.

registrationAgree.title: About these terms
registrationAgree.body: Devices are sold as-is with no warranty or support, and are factory reset before handover. Handover only happens once management approves and the price is paid in full.

employeeImportFormat.title: File format
employeeImportFormat.body: Upload an Excel (.xlsx) file with Staff Number, Name, Department, and Email columns. Matching staff numbers update existing employees; new ones are created.

deviceQuantity.title: About quantity
deviceQuantity.body: How many identical units of this device are available. Most listings are a single unit — list more only if several matching devices are being disposed of together.
